title: Dropout
writer: Tinto Brass, Francesco Longo, Roberto Lerici
actors: Franco Nero, Vanessa Redgrave, Gigi Proietti
plot: Mary is a disillusioned English banker's wife who meets a troubled Italian immigrant, Bruno. Mary is captivated by Bruno and they set off on a voyage together. In the course of their voyage, they meet a series of society's dropouts.
